input: Find summer camps held at colleges and universities (athletics, academics, arts) open to kids for kids and teens in Asheville and Buncombe County, NC. Look past the big, well-known camps: search with varied wording and town names and list every organization you find.
searches: UNC Asheville summer camps 2026 youth pre college

candidates.name: University of North Carolina Asheville
candidates.note: Youth athletics camps, STEAM Studio SkillSet camps, and residential high-school pre-college programs in sciences, arts and writing.

candidates.name: Warren Wilson College
candidates.note: 2026 full- and half-day youth basketball camps; tennis camps and Swannanoa Gathering folk-arts workshops with children's programming.

candidates.name: Montreat College
candidates.note: COMPASS academic immersion for rising high-school sophomores through college freshmen, June 20–24, 2027; also Cavalier sports camps.

candidates.name: Asheville-Buncombe Technical Community College
candidates.note: 2026 Allied Health summer camp with hands-on healthcare labs and career exploration; age eligibility needs confirmation.

candidates.name: US Sports Camps
candidates.note: 2026 Nike baseball and softball camps at Montreat College and boys basketball at Warren Wilson College.
